title: Amazon Dinosaur - Giants Walking
project: Original cinematic cue: Jurassic Park in the Amazon forest, Hans Zimmer-style orchestral
brief: create scoring for cinematic Jurassic Park in Amazon forest, Hans Zimmer like orchestra, not funky, immersive 7.1
audience: Cinema audience hearing a 2-minute adventure cue on 7.1 and stereo; they should feel wonder then dread then triumph
purpose: A 117-second orchestral adventure cue: wonder at giants in the green, dread of the predator, chase, and awe finale. Pressure from ostinato, braam and constant percussion, not from a funk groove.
point_of_view: Narrator/cinema: camera floats over canopy then walks with the herd; no character POV, no diegetic music
job: establish the Amazon as a vast living place before any dinosaur
state an original heroic horn theme the ear can remember
build pressure with a pulse that does not stop, then cut to silence before the predator
chase with the same ostinato faster and denser, not a new groove
finale: theme full orchestra, braam, choir, then a cliff silence and last D chord
story: First sight of giants in the green, herd rises, predator dread on a D pedal, chase, awe finale where the theme returns biggest and ends unresolved-but-triumphant on D.

sections.name: first sight
sections.action: camera pushes over canopy, first giant shape in mist
sections.music: horns alone state theme over low piano D pedal and soft choir; strings enter bar 5

sections.name: herd rises
sections.music: cello ostinato enters, timpani root/fifth, trombone braam at bar 16, theme answered by strings

sections.name: predator dread
sections.music: D pedal, tremolo strings, taiko pulse, tuba braam, silence 2 beats before bar 32

sections.name: chase
sections.music: ostinato thickens to eighths in celli+violas, brass marcato, timpani+taiko constant, piano hammering root

sections.name: awe finale
sections.music: theme full orchestra, choir, trumpet fanfare, braam, orchestra hit then cliff silence, last D chord in room

motifs.name: giants theme
motifs.shape: hymn in D major: D-F#-A-D (fifth leaps), C#-B-A stepwise fall, long half notes
motifs.returns: strings answer at 10.7s, full orchestra at 106.7s, horns alone on last D

motifs.name: ostinato cell
motifs.shape: D-A-D-F# repeated eighths, a few notes changed each 2 bars
motifs.returns: thickens in chase, hammered in finale

pulse: orchestral: cello ostinato eighths + timpani/taiko on beat 1, straight, never syncopated

hits.sound: tuba braam on D pedal, tremolo enters
full brass marcato + timpani hit, after 2-beat silence
hits.why: chase launch, silence before makes it larger

hits.sound: theme full orchestra, choir, trumpet fanfare

mix_intent.executed_by: score carries mix_intent and mix preset lead_carve enabled from_intent

delivery.played_on: cinema 7.1, stereo headphones, living room stereo; stereo first so fold rows compare 7.1

references: in words: a hymn horn theme over low strings, a repeating low ostinato that never stops, low brass blasts, timpani and taiko, wordless choir - the Zimmer epic tropes, original theme
Jurassic wonder: low/middle orchestra first, choir added later, reverent, not a copy of Williams

immersive.why: the field carries the geography of the forest: herd left, predator right, theme centre, finale all around

movers.why: theme stays centre as the herd moves around it
movers.path: centre throughout, choir opens wide in finale

immersive.notes: numbers in presets, section names match score plan

gate_reason: Film cue with a horn melody figure, ostinato pulse and braam hits: cinematic profile judged like melodic, focus melody declares the horns+choir figure

video.notes: music-only piece: leave enabled false. For a cue against a cut, run scripts/video_score.py and it fills this block.

notes: Original theme, not Williams. No ambience asked, none added. No kit/guitar/synth.

expression.sonic_picture: First 10s: solo horns hymn over low piano D and soft choir in a big hall. Middle: cello ostinato never stops, timpani/taiko pulse, braams at turning points. Last note: full orchestra D chord hanging in the room after a hit and silence.
expression.performer: Horns play hymn-like, breathing between phrases, swelling into long notes. Strings lean on beat 1, eighths are bowed straight, not funky. Brass marcato is short and straight. Timpani/taiko are large and slow.
expression.producer_moves: Silence 2 beats before chase and finale, reverb throw on last chord, filter opening is the dynamics arc in the score, not a mix trick.
expression.anti_generic: Generic version is a drum-kit groove, bass guitar, synth arp and flute tune; what stops it is one D pedal, one ostinato cell that never stops, and a horn theme made of fifths and long notes.

cues.dynamics: ff to silence to pp chord

theme.contour: arch: D-F#-A-D up fifths, then C#-B-A fall
theme.interval_character: perfect fifths and steps, no funk leaps
theme.rhythm_cell: half, half, dotted half, quarter, half, half, whole
theme.why_memorable: fifth leaps land on beat 1, long notes, never syncopated
theme.variation_plan: strings answer, chase fragment in brass, full orchestra finale, horns alone last D
